sentences.en: Blondes earn 7% more than women with any other hair color.
sentences.zh: 金发女性比其他头发颜色的女性多赚7%。

sentences.en: Sami's mother was bleaching his hair blond to match hers.
sentences.zh: 萨米的母亲正在漂白他的头发，让他变成和她一样的金色。

sentences.en: Piotr has black hair but Lech has blond hair.
sentences.zh: 皮otr留着黑色的头发，而莱ch则是金色的。
